Lille Model Score

Assesses steroid response in severe alcoholic hepatitis at Day 7

Normal: 35-50 g/L
Or enter INR below instead
Will be converted to approximate PT
Interpretation:
• <0.45: Steroid responder - continue prednisolone to Day 28
• ≥0.45: Non-responder - consider stopping steroids
• >0.56: Complete non-responder, high mortality
Note: Used AFTER 7 days of prednisolone 40mg/day
Reference: Louvet A et al. Hepatology 2007
